name: How do I choose the right contractor for kitchen door frame repair?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for kitchen door frame repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a licensed, insured remodeling contractor with direct experience in finish carpentry and moisture remediation. A qualified specialist should ask about underlying causes—such as foundation settling or dishwasher leaks—rather than merely patching surface cosmetics. Request photos of prior casing and jamb repairs, verify that they carry general liability insurance, and confirm that their estimate clearly outlines whether materials, hardware realignment, and finish work are included in the scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed finish carpentry or remodeling contractor who addresses the root cause of the damage, provides clear written estimates, and carries proper liability coverage.
